# Streaming Price Check

> Independent, research-based guide to US streaming services and devices at https://streaming.samcbarth.com. Prices come from official provider pages and were last checked November 9, 2026. No invented ratings or hands-on claims.

## Reviews
- [Netflix review](https://streaming.samcbarth.com/reviews/netflix/): Netflix is the safest single pick if you want a large original library and no live TV. The ad plan costs $8.99 a month; ad-free starts at $19.99, and 4K needs the $26.99 Premium plan.
- [Hulu review](https://streaming.samcbarth.com/reviews/hulu/): Hulu is best bought as part of the Disney+, Hulu bundle: $12.99 a month with ads, only 50 cents more than Hulu alone at $12.49. Ad-free Hulu by itself costs $21.49.
- [Disney+ review](https://streaming.samcbarth.com/reviews/disney-plus/): Disney+ is the top family pick, but it is rarely worth buying alone: the Disney+, Hulu bundle with ads costs $12.99 a month, just 50 cents more than Disney+ by itself at $12.49.
- [HBO Max review](https://streaming.samcbarth.com/reviews/hbo-max/): HBO Max starts at $10.99 a month with ads and $18.49 ad-free. It is the best pick for HBO originals and Warner Bros. movies; 4K needs Premium at $22.99.
- [Peacock review](https://streaming.samcbarth.com/reviews/peacock/): Peacock Premium costs $12.99 a month with ads and includes NBC live sports; Premium Plus is $19.99 ad-free. The $8.99 Select plan skips sports, movies and originals.
- [Paramount+ review](https://streaming.samcbarth.com/reviews/paramount-plus/): Paramount+ is the cheapest major service with a mostly ad-free plan: Premium is $13.99 a month and includes live local CBS. Essential with ads is $8.99.
- [Prime Video review](https://streaming.samcbarth.com/reviews/prime-video/): If you already have Amazon Prime ($14.99 a month or $139 a year), Prime Video is included with ads. Removing ads costs $4.99 a month more. Video-only Prime Video is $8.99.
- [Apple TV review](https://streaming.samcbarth.com/reviews/apple-tv/): Apple TV (the service formerly called Apple TV+) costs $14.99 a month or $119 a year, with no ads and 4K included. It is a small, originals-only catalog.
- [YouTube TV review](https://streaming.samcbarth.com/reviews/youtube-tv/): YouTube TV's base plan is $82.99 a month for 100+ live channels, including local ABC, CBS, FOX and NBC in most markets, with unlimited DVR. Cheaper genre plans start at $64.99.
- [Sling TV review](https://streaming.samcbarth.com/reviews/sling-tv/): Sling TV is the lowest-cost live TV service with big cable networks: Orange or Blue is $45.99 a month, both together $60.99, and smaller Select and Essentials plans are $19.99.
- [Fubo review](https://streaming.samcbarth.com/reviews/fubo/): Fubo is the sports-focused live TV service. Pro costs $88.99 a month and Elite $98.99, with first-month discounts. A Spanish-language Latino plan is $19.99.
- [Philo review](https://streaming.samcbarth.com/reviews/philo/): Philo is the cheapest live TV service for entertainment channels: $25 a month for 70+ channels. It has no sports networks and no local channels.

## Guides
- [Best streaming service for sports](https://streaming.samcbarth.com/best/sports/): For the most sports in one place, YouTube TV ($82.99) or Fubo (Pro $88.99) are the strongest picks because they carry local networks plus ESPN. On a budget, pair Sling Orange ($45.99) with Peacock ($12.99) or Paramount+ ($8.99) for specific leagues.
- [Best streaming service for kids](https://streaming.samcbarth.com/best/kids/): Disney+ is the best fit for most families because of its Disney, Pixar and Marvel library. The Disney+, Hulu bundle at $12.99 a month with ads adds shows for adults for 50 cents more than Disney+ alone.
- [Cheapest streaming services](https://streaming.samcbarth.com/best/cheapest/): The cheapest major paid plans are Netflix Standard with ads, Peacock Select, Paramount+ Essential and Prime Video standalone, all at $8.99 a month. The cheapest ad-free plan among the big services is Paramount+ Premium at $13.99.
- [Best live TV streaming service](https://streaming.samcbarth.com/best/live-tv/): YouTube TV is the best all-around cable replacement at $82.99 a month: local networks in most markets, ESPN, 100+ channels and unlimited DVR. Sling TV ($45.99) and Philo ($25) are cheaper but leave out local channels.
